errors.evidence: The description identifies slice B (治疗) as "深灰色" (dark gray), but the slice is colored dark purplish-blue. More importantly, it uses the same color description for slice F, which has a different color (dark slate blue).

The description identifies slice F (其他) as "深灰色" (dark gray), but the slice is colored dark slate blue. It also incorrectly uses the same color description for slice B, which has a different color (dark purplish-blue).

errors.text_span: 锻炼（D2）占比0.6%，为浅蓝；减肥（D3）占比0.1%，为深蓝
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the colors for the "锻炼" (D2) and "减肥" (D3) categories in the smaller pie chart. The figure shows that D2 is dark blue and D3 is light blue, the opposite of what is described.

errors.text_span: 主饼图中的各个切片均标有类别标签、对应百分比，且通过引线与标签连接
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that all slices in the main chart are connected to their labels via leader lines. In the figure, only slices E and F use leader lines; slices A, B, C, and D have their labels placed inside the slice.

errors.text_span: 切片按面积大小大致呈递减顺序排列，从最大切片“健康生活方式”顺时针方向依次递减
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are sorted in descending order clockwise from the largest slice (D). This is factually incorrect. Following D (27.8%) clockwise, the next slice is A (9%), which is a decrease, but the one after that is B (25.3%), which is an increase. The slices are not sorted in this order.
